NLP (Natural Language Processing) is a field of AI that helps computers read, understand and generate human language. Chatbots, translators and search engines all use it.

patterns: what is the natural language toolkit
responses: NLTK is the Natural Language Toolkit, a popular Python library for text processing: tokenizing, stemming, tagging, parsing and more. This bot uses its tokenizer and Porter stemmer.

TF-IDF (Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency) scores how important a word is to a text compared with a whole collection. Common words get low weights and distinctive words get high weights, which makes it great for matching sentences.

patterns: how do you match my message
responses: Cosine similarity measures the angle between two vectors. A score of 1 means the sentences point in the same direction (very similar) and 0 means they share nothing. I use it to compare your message with my known patterns.

I clean your text (lowercase, tokenize, remove stop words, stem), turn it into a TF-IDF vector, and compare it with all my example patterns using cosine similarity. The best match above a threshold decides my reply.
